edits.after:
CHROMIUM_STORE="$(nix build --no-link --print-out-paths .#ci-chromium)"
          CHROME_BIN=""
          for candidate in \
            "$CHROMIUM_STORE/chromium-1228/chrome-linux64/chrome" \
            "$CHROMIUM_STORE/chromium-1228/chrome-linux/chrome"; do
            if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then CHROME_BIN="$candidate"; break; fi
          done
          test -n "$CHROME_BIN"
          test -x "$CHROME_BIN"
          CHROME_WRAPPED="$(dirname "$CHROME_BIN")/.chrome-wrapped"
          test -x "$CHROME_WRAPPED"
          case "$(uname -m)" in
            x86_64)
              expected_chrome_sha=dbc8b199f83056aba947868710648f61c1d23c3f64c6a491c6f72ef2ebaf3f60
              expected_wrapped_sha=e8006643ad430fcf8b0545c5b68625d4525826916773c85cbf757c78d16b2ee0
              ;;
            aarch64|arm64)
              expected_chrome_sha=3a0b4b909e867cbd845162be0b67343c0d6bb03dbac8f2d410eec8fcc8913fe9
              expected_wrapped_sha=eff7bad2ac10e1288fc52919ff9791a0d500a10c870c831ca8426b457a324d95
              ;;
            *) echo "Unsupported Chromium runner architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          actual_chrome_sha="$(sha256sum "$CHROME_BIN" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          actual_wrapped_sha="$(sha256sum "$CHROME_WRAPPED" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
          test "$actual_chrome_sha" = "$expected_chrome_sha"
          test "$actual_wrapped_sha" = "$expected_wrapped_sha"
          printf 'CHROME_BIN_SHA256=%s\nCHROME_WRAPPED_SHA256=%s\n' "$actual_chrome_sha" "$actual_wrapped_sha"
          "$CHROME_BIN" --version
          nix path-info --json "$CHROMIUM_STORE"
          echo "CHROME_BIN=$CHROME_BIN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
